verdicts.reason: A and B are practically identical; B's text block is shifted only a couple of pixels. Both have the same problems. The translucent vertical band is now a narrow strip off to the right of centre, so 'London' and the tagline run past both of its edges. 'Save your money, enjoy your weekend' sits right on top of the busy skyline with weak contrast. The '<<<' and '>>>' chevrons float in arbitrary spots and no longer frame the copy. The cropped photo is soft and upscaled, and the lower half of the canvas is unused city texture, so this reads as a crop rather than a deliberate re-layout.
